title: PNG/PDF export regression corpus and fidelity report expansion
outcome: A versioned export regression corpus (documents plus expected PDF operator topology and PNG pixel checksums) is checked in and runnable, so compound-path behavior proven by VIRO-0005 becomes part of the standing baseline and future exporter changes are measured against real artifacts, with the export report expanded to cover every claimed classification.
before: VIRO-0005 delivered compound-contour vector PDF export with targeted tests (tests/pdf-compound.test.mjs, tests/pdf-compound.spec.ts), but there is no standing versioned corpus of export documents covering single/compound/stroke/effects/text/raster mixes, and PdfExportReport coverage of every field it reports is incomplete.
after: One command regenerates and one command verifies the corpus; every corpus document has committed expected artifacts (operator-level for PDF, checksums for PNG); report fields (vectorPaths, rasterFallbacks, others) each have an assertion.
acceptance: Corpus includes: single-contour vector, compound boolean ring, disjoint union, stroke-only, fill+stroke, text layer, raster layer, and effects layer.
Verification command fails on any operator-topology or pixel-checksum divergence.
Every PdfExportReport field asserted at least once across the corpus.
npx tsc --noEmit, corpus suite and npm run build pass.
evidence: Deliberate-mutation check: one seeded exporter mutation makes verification fail (corpus is not vacuous)

critic.notes: Test/QA corpus; no product behavior change intended.

delta.before: Point tests for compound export; no standing corpus or report-field coverage.
delta.after: Versioned corpus with artifact-level verification commands and full report-field assertions.
regression_protection: tests/pdf-compound.* remain green and are folded into the corpus
